utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can help with sorting donations and flyers this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Nell — that’s a big help. I’ll check the fence and lamp post when I get there and see if anything else needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll be there Saturday to help with the donations and flyers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: 3:30 still works for me, and I can start lining things up right after school pickup. What would you like me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you confirm the exact spot for the repair drive? I want to make sure everyone knows where to go.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the exact spot and send it along so everyone knows where to go. If you want, I can also add a simple landmark to make it easier to find.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll bring those along for the repair drive. If you think of anything else people might need, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus—that should help a lot. I’ll keep an eye out for anything else people might need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, just keep me posted and I’ll bring the tools by when the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I can mention it to a few neighbors and help get folks lined up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and share the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — just send me the time and place when you have it, and I’ll keep telling folks.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Kira — I’ll keep track of supplies and let folks know if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes — please send the repair drive details over, and I’ll make sure they get to everyone who needs them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll send the time, place, and what items to bring over right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That would be wonderful, Ira—just stop by whenever you’re able, and I’ll find you a spot at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing, Quinn—I’ll swing by when I’m done running errands and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Ira—thanks so much! Enjoy your errands, and I’ll be here if you do hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Still on—I’m dropping off a few things this afternoon. If you’ve got anything to add, I can swing by and pick it up too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be great, thanks. Do you know roughly what time you’re going, so I don’t miss you?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Around 3 this afternoon. I’ll text when I’m on the way.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’ve still got a few things open—sorting tools, carrying supplies, and checking on the broken benches. If you’re free, I could use an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—tools, supplies, and the broken benches. I’ll make a quick list and check if anything else needs attention before we start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Hana—that’d help a lot. Let me know if you spot anything else, and I’ll be there with an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Rey — I’ll keep asking around and coordinate the volunteers and supplies. I’ll let you know as soon as I find someone with a pickup truck.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa — I appreciate it. Let me know if there’s anything small I can help with, too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate that. I’ll let you know if I need help, and I’ll keep you posted on the volunteers and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think they’re collecting every afternoon through Friday, around 3 to 6. If you want, I can double-check the exact hours for you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. If you could double-check, I’d appreciate it—I’ll try to come by if I’m able.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll check the exact hours and let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What’s still left to fix for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Mostly the small stuff: a loose shelf, a squeaky door, and a couple of wobbly fixtures. If we stick to the list, we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—who’s handling those, and do you need anything else from me?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the repair drive details and I’ll skim them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll send the repair drive details over. Thanks for being in, Bo—just let me know if you can make it to the community shed around 4.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can probably make it around 4—send me the details and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Mara—spreading the word and checking for tools would be a huge help. Let me know who’s in, and I’ll make sure Kira gets the list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, please send me the repair drive details so I can confirm who’s in and pass the list along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send you the details right away and keep spreading the word. Thanks, Kira; I’ll make sure you get the updated list as people reply.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out and let you know if I hear any new updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure everyone knows the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll do the same while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That should do it—let’s stick with the list and meet at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll be there at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, see you then — I’ll have the list ready and we’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll jot those down and take one quick walk around before we start. If I spot anything else, I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Hana—that helps a lot. Once you’ve got the list, send it over and I’ll match it to the pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Will do—I’ll send the list over after my walkaround so you can line it up with the pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds doable—I can help sort donations and hand out flyers this Saturday if you still need me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be a huge help, thanks. Just send me the repair drive details and I’ll skim them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing—I’ll send over the details so you can take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, a few things are still open—mainly sorting tools, carrying supplies, and checking in on the broken benches. If you’re free, I could use an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help once I get there—happy to sort tools or carry supplies, and I’ll take a look at the benches too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be a huge help, Dane—thank you. Just find me when you arrive, and I’ll point you to the tools and the benches.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still a bit worried about the timing—do we know exactly when they’re collecting? I’d hate to show up and miss it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not totally sure—didn’t Leo say he’d be dropping items off this afternoon? I can check in and see if there’s a more exact time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — can you confirm the repair drive is at the community shed and starts around 4?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — it’s at the community shed, and 4 sounds right.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks Leo — I’ll plan to meet everyone at the community shed around 4.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, I appreciate that. I’ll do my best to stop by if I’m able.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — no pressure, just come if you can. I’ll be at the community shed around 4 with the spare tools and duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I’ll try to make it around 4 if I’m able.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think they’re collecting every afternoon through Friday, around 3 to 6. If you want, I can double-check the exact hours for you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Tess — could you double-check the exact hours? Also, do they still need help sorting donations this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll check the exact hours and ask about Saturday sorting too. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey — I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got the time and place set. Appreciate it!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — once you’ve got the time and place, I’ll help keep track of any supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — that’d be a huge help. I’m still ironing out the details, but I’ll tell you as soon as I’ve got the time and place set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it—I’ll bring the hammer, screwdrivers, drill, and tape measure. If anything else comes up, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — that covers a lot. I’ll keep sharing the invite and see who can bring extra tools or help on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds great, Mara — I’ll be there Saturday with the tools, and I’m happy to help wherever needed.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
